name: plugin.critic_loop
description: Authoritative critic, rubric evaluation, destructive command safety gate, and dialectical debate arbiter.

entrypoints.name: evaluate_rubric
entrypoints.description: Evaluate draft text or code against a criteria checklist and produce itemized scoring

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The draft text or code to evaluate

parameters.name: rubric
parameters.description: List of criteria assertions to check

entrypoints.name: run_critic_loop
entrypoints.description: Run iterative multi-turn critique and refinement until threshold score is achieved

entrypoints.name: critic_check_safety
entrypoints.description: Scan a CLI shell command for dangerous, destructive, or irreversible operations

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Shell command line to inspect for destructive operations

entrypoints.name: critic_evaluate_code
entrypoints.description: Statically analyze code syntax, AST complexity, function docstrings, and potential anti-patterns

entrypoints.name: critic_review_plan
entrypoints.description: Evaluate an execution plan for verification steps, risks, and missing safeguards

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: List of planned action steps as strings

entrypoints.name: conduct_dialectical_debate
entrypoints.description: Structure dialectical argument rounds between Proposer and Challenger

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The subject or proposal under debate

entrypoints.name: synthesize_debate_verdict
entrypoints.description: Synthesize an impartial arbiter decision based on debate rounds
